holderQuote: Imenet fell, grabbing at his leg. He wasn’t bleeding.
Behind him strode Falene. Erin heard her speaking as she raised her staff.
The half-Elf pointed at the ground.
effectQuote: The shockwave blasted him off his feet and into the air.
They rained down around the street.

holderQuote: The leaping shadow hit the shimmering barrier that appeared and Seborn stumbled back. Ulinde took that moment and pointed both wands.
effectQuote: It caught him, but the [Rogue] was already tumbling, flipping sideways with the force of the blast.
